The cheapest plan is to rescue the 3 adults at Likhu school and defer the 3 adults at Benighat farm, for a total cost of 102.

**Why:** The direct road from Naukunda shelter to Benighat farm is impassable. The only way to reach Benighat farm is through Likhu school, which takes 43 min each way. A round trip from the shelter to Likhu school takes 42 min.

**Options compared:**

| Option | Driving | Penalty | Total |
|---|---|---|---|
| Rescue everyone (two trips needed, since the car holds 4) | 86 + 42 = 128 | 0 | 128 |
| Rescue 4: 3 from Benighat plus 1 from Likhu (or 1 from Benighat plus 3 from Likhu), defer 2 | 86 | 40 | 126 |
| Rescue the 3 at Likhu, defer the 3 at Benighat | 42 | 60 | **102** |
| Defer everyone | 0 | 120 | 120 |

<plan>
drive car1 naukunda-shelter likhu-school
load car1 adult 3
drive car1 likhu-school naukunda-shelter
unload car1 adult 3
defer benighat-farm adult 3
</plan>

COST: 102
